maintenance_led.reason: Builds and sells new entry-level single-family homes to first-time buyers; revenue is new construction, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Homes are sold to private consumers, paid by buyers and mortgage lenders, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and selling homes in its own communities and expanding markets, not through a stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers make a one-time purchase and can choose among competing builders; no switching cost exists before purchase.
